curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With one robber dead and another freshly killed, the last man has vanished with $20 million and a seven-year head start.
curatedMovie.description: Years after a $20 million Detroit heist, an ex-convict surfaces dead in Miami. Posing as local police, FBI partners Doug Bennet and Steve Forest take on the case to track down the missing cash and the final fugitive.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Brisk, funny, and effortlessly exciting. A light action-comedy caper built for casual hangs and zero-friction viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action-comedy crime setup combines an old bank robbery with FBI agents working undercover in Miami.
